title: Create request (input, contract v2)
description: A request to agentspace lease create. The CLI takes it as flags and arguments only and never reads this document; it defines the request for validation, and for the hosted API (#0011), which takes it as JSON. Tolerant in form (any case, surrounding whitespace, null for not given) and strict in meaning (unknown members and ambiguous values are refused). The TTL's range, 1 minute to 24 hours, is checked after parsing, not here. A plan and a size are never both given, since the plan picks the size. A board and an epic are given together or not at all, and never with a plan or a size, since the epic's plan, read from the board, picks the size. A turn is given only with a plan or a board, and is matched exactly, never trimmed or case-folded; that it names a turn of the plan is checked once the plan is read. The plan's $defs are copied word for word from plan.input.schema.json, because Test-Json -SchemaFile does not resolve a $ref to another file, and what that schema cannot check is checked after parsing. See docs/lease-api.md.

project.description: Letters, digits and '-', 1 to 32, starting and ending with a letter or digit, in any case.

platform.description: os/arch or os/arch/variant in any case; the arch MAY be aarch64, x86_64 or x86-64. Null or absent means linux/arm64.

profile.description: name or name@version in any case; the version is 1 or more, leading zeros allowed. Null or absent means agent-linux.

size.description: 1 to 8 letters and digits in any case. Null or absent means m, or, with a plan or a board, the size the plan picks. Refused with a plan or a board that is not null.

ttl.description: A duration with units. Null or absent means 8 hours, or, with a plan whose turn has a budget, the TTL that budget gives.

plan.description: The plan document, as plan.input.schema.json defines it, from which the size is picked. On the command line, --plan names a file that holds it. Null or absent means no plan, or, with a board, the epic's plan. Refused with a board that is not null.

board.description: The ID of the localswim board that holds the epic: a UUIDv4 in any case, as a lease ID is. Given with epic, whose plan is read from this board. Null or absent means no board.

epic.description: The epic's ticket number on the board: 1 to 16 decimal digits, leading zeros allowed, not all zeros, given as a string and never as a JSON number. Its range, 1 to 9007199254740991, is checked after parsing, not here. Given with board. Null or absent means no epic.

turn.description: The name of the plan's turn the lease is for, as a turn's name is written in a plan, never trimmed or case-folded. That the plan has a turn of this name is checked once the plan is read, not here. Refused without a plan or a board that is not null. Null or absent means the plan's busiest turn.

plan.description: A plan document: an optional name, such as its epic's, and its turns in order.

name.description: The plan's name, printed as sized_for.plan. Null or absent means the plan has none.

turns.description: The plan's turns in order, 1 to 32.

plan_turn.description: A turn: its name, unique in the plan, its stories, which run at once, and its budget, if it has one.

budget_minutes.description: The turn's wall-clock budget in whole minutes, 1 to 960, from which a lease for this turn takes its TTL. Null or absent means the turn has none.

plan_story.description: A story: its name, unique in its turn, and its subagents. Its peak is counted from the subagents' after lists, never stated.

plan_subagent.description: A subagent: its name, unique in its story, its model and effort, and the subagents of the same story it starts after.

after.description: The names of the same story's subagents this one starts after, each once, at most 31. Null, absent or empty means it starts after none.

plan_name.description: A name in a plan, as given: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters, not starting or ending with a space. Never trimmed or case-folded.

plan_model.description: A model, as given, such as Opus or Opus 5.5: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters, not starting or ending with a space, as a name in a plan is. Never trimmed or case-folded, and never a list of names, so a new model needs no new version.

plan_effort.description: An effort, as given: 1 to 32 ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or digit. Never a list of names, so a new effort needs no new version.

ttl.description: Short form (8h, 90m, 1h30m, '2 hours'; units d, h and s in any case and m in lowercase only, or their words in any case, largest first, each once, with optional whitespace between and around them) or ISO 8601 P[nD][T[nH][nM][nS]] in any case. A bare number, an uppercase M in the short form, weeks, months, years and fractions are refused.
